description: The clip view of an arrangement's audio clip: a Clip box (switch, name, start and end or loop position and length in bars.beats.16ths, signature, Loop) and an Audio box (Warp, Reverse, Crop, Gain, Transpose, and the speed with ×2 and ÷2 when warped) beside its source on a timeline of its own (overview, bar ruler, the stretch it plays or loops to drag, warp markers on the waveform). Folds down to its title.
name: clip-panel
